# Astro v2.3.1 - Table of Contents

> Astronomical calculations in Elixir including sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset,
equinox, solstice, moonphase and more.

## Pages

- [Astro](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Sun &amp; Moon Rise and Set Accuracy Comparisons](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/rise_and_set_comparisons.md)

## Modules

- [Astro](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.md): High-level API for common astronomical observations.
- [Astro.Coordinates](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Coordinates.md): Coordinate transformations for high-precision lunar and solar
position calculations.
- [Astro.Earth](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Earth.md): Earth constants, nutation, and elevation-related corrections
for rise/set calculations.
- [Astro.Ephemeris](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Ephemeris.md): Computes the geocentric position of the Moon using a JPL DE440s (or
compatible) SPK binary ephemeris kernel.
- [Astro.Ephemeris.Downloader](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Ephemeris.Downloader.md): Downloads JPL DE-series SPK binary ephemeris files from NASA NAIF.
- [Astro.Ephemeris.Kernel](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Ephemeris.Kernel.md): Parses JPL DE-series binary SPK ephemeris files (DAF/SPK format).
- [Astro.Lunar](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Lunar.md): Calculates lunar position, phases, distance and related quantities.
- [Astro.Lunar.CrescentVisibility](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Lunar.CrescentVisibility.md): Implements three criteria for predicting the visibility of the new
crescent moon: Yallop (1997), Odeh (2006), and Schaefer (1988/2000).
- [Astro.Lunar.MoonRiseSet](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Lunar.MoonRiseSet.md): Computes moonrise and moonset times using the JPL DE440s ephemeris and a
fully topocentric bisection algorithm.
- [Astro.Solar](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Solar.md): Solar position, orbital mechanics, and equinox/solstice calculations.
- [Astro.Solar.SunRiseSet](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Solar.SunRiseSet.md): Computes sunrise and sunset times using the JPL DE440s ephemeris and a
scan-and-bisect algorithm.
- [Astro.Supervisor](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Supervisor.md): Provides a supervision tree under which
the required TzWorld backend server can
be started.
- [Astro.Time](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Astro.Time.md): Time scales, conversions, and calendar utilities for astronomical calculations.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix astro.download_ephemeris](https://astro.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Astro.DownloadEphemeris.md): Downloads the JPL DE440s ephemeris file (`de440s.bsp`) from NASA's
NAIF server and places it in the application's `priv` directory.
